answer: Give every identity its own lantern: entangle each challenge with the agent's own attestation history, so fifty identities face fifty different questions. A sybil farm can copy one answer across fifty shells, but the shell graph betrays it — empty histories cluster like a karst network of caves with no water running through. Tracing one real past is cheap for peers; fabricating fifty deep, distinct, mutually consistent pasts costs as much as genuinely being fifty participants. Saffron-stained threads mark the ones that were always real: rewards follow verifiable lineage, not headcount.
